clues.text: This place is a city in Peru. It serves as the capital of its department there.
clues.narrowing: rules out every place outside Peru

source.quote: It is the capital of the department of Huancavelica and according to the 2017 census had a population of 49,570 people.

clues.text: From February to August, the air is cold and dry. A rainy season fills the rest of the year.
clues.narrowing: rules out places without a long cold dry season and a clear rainy season

source.quote: It has an approximate altitude of 3,676 metres (12,060 ft); the climate is cold and dry between the months of February and August with a rainy season between September and January.

clues.text: This city got its start on August 5, 1572. It was set up by Francisco de Toledo, viceroy of Peru.

clues.text: This place has a hard claim to fame. It is counted among the poorest cities in all of Peru.

clues.text: This city sits in Portugal, far from the sea. It is known as the past capital of the Alentejo.
clues.narrowing: rules out coastal Portugal and places outside the Alentejo region

source.quote: It is considered the historic capital of the Alentejo region and serves as the seat of the Évora District.

clues.text: This city is one of the hottest in Portugal in the summer. Heat waves strike it often.
clues.narrowing: rules out cool coastal cities in Portugal; points to a hot inland summer

source.quote: Due to its inland position, Évora is one of Portugal's hottest cities in the summer, frequently subject to heatwaves.

clues.text: Its old town became a World Heritage Site in 1986. Old walls and monuments from many ages still stand there.
clues.narrowing: rules out Portuguese cities without a protected old town from 1986

source.quote: Due to its well-preserved old town centre, still partially enclosed by medieval walls, and many monuments dating from various historical periods, including a Roman Temple, Évora is a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1986.

clues.text: Each year, a survey asks how good life is in each city. This city comes in second in Portugal.
clues.narrowing: rules out all but the top few most livable cities in Portugal

source.quote: Évora is ranked number two in the Portuguese most livable cities survey of living conditions published yearly by Expresso.

clues.text: Look for a Roman temple still standing now in the heart of its old town.

source.quote: Due to its well-preserved old town centre, still partially enclosed by medieval walls, and many monuments dating from various historical periods, including a Roman Temple, Évora is a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1986.

clues.text: This is a mountain resort town in north Punjab, in Pakistan. It sits under the west Himalayas.
clues.narrowing: rules out all places outside northern Pakistan and its western Himalayan hills

source.quote: Murree is a mountain resort city in the northernmost region of the Punjab province of Pakistan. Lying in the Galyat region of the Pir Panjal Range under the western Himalayas, it is located in the northeast of the capital city of Islamabad.

clues.text: In summer, British troops left the fierce heat of the plains for this hill town. Its high ground was a place to rest and heal.
clues.narrowing: rules out low plain towns that gave no summer escape from fierce heat

source.quote: The town was built in the mid-19th century and served as the summer capital of the British Punjab, allowing British troops to escape the scorching heat of the plains of Punjab.

source.quote: Construction of the town started in 1851 on the hills of Murree as a sanatorium for British troops.
